item.title: Flinders Ranges World Heritage bid officially lodged with UNESCO
item.description: The Flinders Ranges has been officially nominated for UNESCO World Heritage listing, recognising its globally significant fossil record, ancient geology and deep Adnyamathanha cultural heritage. A decision could be made as early as 2027.

item.title: Severe Weather Warning for heavy, locally intense rainfall issued for SA
item.description: A Severe Weather Warning has been issued for heavy, locally intense rainfall across South Australia, with flash flooding possible and up to 100mm forecast in parts of the state as the risk increases for Adelaide on Sunday.
